The '''OHS2132-04 system''' was located in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Between [[25,120 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]], it was known as the '''Ulonsus system''' and was situated in the Kiirium Reaches region, a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Ulonsus [[Star system/Legends|system]] was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[OHS4140-02 system/Legends|Balshebr]], [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni]], and [[OHS1782-03 system/Legends|Xoraes systems]], and Xim moved his forces from [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]] to Ulonsus and then to Xoraes.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The OHS2132-04 system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square T-7.<ref name="TEA" />
